numerical_and_quality_guards: All19 candidate live_E2E and free-running-quality fields remain NOT_RUN.
Eight natural calibration items per domain cannot establish1pp/2pp noninferiority; degenerate bootstrap intervals do not prove population equivalence.
Constant-token/teacher-controlled hardware timing is not natural quality or quality-equivalent speedup.
Cross-TP and cross-backend natural outputs differ. Do not interpret natural latency ratios as pure systems gain when work differs.
C07 bitwise failure is unresolved and supplies zero service trials, no quality/acceptance result, and no architecture rejection.
Storage v1/v2 attribution remains invalid/unvalidated. V4 provenance and one-call prefill binding do not resolve numerical differences or cached-decode bindings.
Allfour original-gate observer requests pass token/depth/NFE/lifecycle gates but fail timing/drift validity. No quantitative bottleneck attribution.
C06 sparse-delta result is bounded CPU structural evidence from two continuity prompts and three selected layers, not sparse arithmetic or quality speedup.
C14 first-token-quarter interpolation is MODEL_ESTIMATE, not a bound or measured PP prefill; its negative budgets do not reject every pipeline.
No measured HBM-traffic counter or P8 latency result is supplied by these reports.
